context: I am building a B2B SaaS analytics dashboard for marketing teams. It needs onboarding, workspace selection, campaign overview, report builder, billing, and settings. The style should be dense, premium, dark, and enterprise-grade.
goals: Help marketing teams understand campaign performance quickly.
Make report creation predictable and repeatable.
Expose billing and workspace settings without hiding account state.
Give a coding agent enough structure to implement the frontend without guessing routes or states.
businessGoals: Reduce time from product brief to frontend scaffold.
Make implementation coverage auditable before handoff.

referenceImages.label: analytics dashboard
referenceImages.notes: Dense dark dashboard with left navigation, KPI rows, campaign table, and chart panels.

referenceImages.label: report builder
referenceImages.notes: Multi-step report builder with filters, preview, saved views, and export action.
